title: Terms of use and privacy
intro: {{company}} is online software to manage a store’s orders (confirmation, delivery, stock, cash). By creating a store, you accept these terms.

s1.p: You log in with your e-mail and a password only you know: keep it secret. The person who creates a store is its owner; only they can delete it.

s2.p: Your store’s orders, customers, products and figures are yours. The Pilotix team has no access inside your store from its control room and sells your data to no one. For billing, it only sees numbers: how many accounts, drivers and orders per month.

s3.p: We keep what the service needs: your name, e-mail, phone, your store’s data and a log of logins. A backup is made every night.

s4.p: Each new store gets a free trial. After that, the subscription is paid according to the chosen plan. Without payment, access is locked after a grace period; orders keep coming in and are kept.

s5.p: Don’t use Pilotix for products or activities the law forbids, or to send unwanted messages. A store that breaks these rules can be suspended.

s6.p: The owner can delete their store in Settings: all its data is erased for good. Payments already made stay in our accounts.

s7.p: A question about your data or these terms? Write to us at {{email}} or from “Contact Pilotix” in your store.

s2ai.t: Pilot AI: Dellal learns to sell better
s2ai.p: When Pilotix turns on Pilot AI for your shop, the chats of Dellal (the sales assistant) are read every night to teach it to sell better. Names, numbers, addresses, products and prices are removed inside your shop before anything is read; the Pilotix team may read these anonymous chats to approve lessons. Your prices, products and customers are never shown to other shops. You can ask at any time for your shop to stop taking part: what was kept is then deleted.

sfb.t: Your Facebook, Instagram and TikTok accounts
sfb.p: In Pilot AI › Accounts, a store can link its Facebook account (with its Pages and Instagram accounts) or its TikTok account. Pilotix then receives the account’s name and picture, the Pages, Instagram accounts and ad accounts you choose, and access keys. These keys stay on Pilotix’s server and are never shown. They are used for three things only: answering Messenger and Instagram messages (Dellal), answering comments on your posts (CM AI) and reading your ad numbers. The messages and comments received are kept in your store, like your other conversations. Pilotix does not sell this data, does not show it to other stores and posts nothing on your Pages except your agents’ answers.

sdel.t: Deleting your Facebook, Instagram or TikTok data
sdel.p: At any time, you can cut Pilotix’s access and have what it kept erased:
steps: In Pilotix: the store’s owner or an administrator opens Pilot AI › Accounts and clicks “Remove” next to the account. Its access keys and the list of its Pages and ad accounts are erased at once, and your agents stop answering on those Pages.

On Facebook: profile picture › Settings & privacy › Settings › Business integrations. Choose Pilotix, then “Remove” (direct link: facebook.com/settings?tab=business_tools). Pilotix then has no access at all to your account or your Pages.
By e-mail: write to {{email}} saying which account to erase. We erase what Pilotix keeps about that account within 30 days at most and confirm it by e-mail.
If the owner deletes the store (in Settings), the accounts linked to that store only, its messages and its comments are erased too.
notes: Nightly backups keep a copy for 14 days at most, then it is erased.

Did you write to a store on Messenger, Instagram or TikTok? Your messages are kept in that store to answer you and follow your order. To have them erased, ask the store, or write to us at {{email}} with the store’s name and your profile name: we erase them within 30 days at most.
